text.hi: अपनी किताब में पेज 62-63 पर डेंगू, मलेरिया और चिकनगुनिया वाला पैराग्राफ़ पढ़ो।
text.hinglish: Apni kitaab mein page 62-63 par dengue, malaria aur chikungunya waala paragraph padho.
text.en: Read the passage about dengue, malaria and chikungunya on pages 62–63 of your book.

steps.question: Name the diseases mentioned in the passage.

questionMeaning.hi: पैराग्राफ़ में कौन सी बीमारियाँ हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Paragraph mein kaun si beemaariyaan hain?

steps.question: Is there any vaccine for these diseases?
options: No, there is no vaccine for all these diseases.
steps.answer: No, there is no vaccine for all these diseases.

steps.question: What should we do if we have fever?
options: See a doctor and get a lab test.
steps.answer: See a doctor and get a lab test.
steps.modelAnswer: If we have fever, we should go to a doctor. Only a doctor, after laboratory tests, can find out which disease it is.

modelMeaning.hi: बुख़ार हो तो डॉक्टर के पास जाना चाहिए। सिर्फ़ डॉक्टर ही जाँच के बाद बीमारी पहचान सकते हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Bukhaar ho to doctor ke paas jaana chahiye. Sirf doctor hi jaanch ke baad beemaari pehchaan sakte hain.

steps.question: Which is a preventive measure against these diseases?

questionMeaning.hi: बचाव का कौन सा तरीक़ा सही है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Bachaav ka kaun sa tareeqa sahi hai?

options: Drain stagnant water from coolers and pots.
steps.answer: Drain stagnant water from coolers and pots.
steps.modelAnswer: Use mosquito nets, wear protective clothing, don't let water stagnate, drain coolers and potted plants, and spray pesticides.

modelMeaning.hi: मच्छरदानी लगाओ, पूरे कपड़े पहनो, पानी जमा न होने दो, कूलर और गमलों का पानी निकालो, और दवा छिड़को।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Machchhardaani lagaao, poore kapde pehno, paani jama na hone do, cooler aur gamlon ka paani nikaalo, aur dava chhidko.

text.hi: (5) उलझे अक्षर ठीक करके शब्द बनाओ।
text.hinglish: (5) Uljhe akshar theek karke shabd banao.
text.en: (5) Arrange the jumbled letters to make words.
